To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pyridopyridazines are synthesized from the 2, 6-diaryl pypiperidinones by the Mannich-type reaction and intramolecular cyclisation.
the 4-amide pyridopyridazine derivatives were synthesized by two facile steps, and the 3-amide pyridazinone derivatives were synthesized in a facile step.

the 2, 6-diaryl p-tert- butylbenzenamine derivatives, obtained via Mannich-type three component condensation, underwent intramolecular condensation in the presence of a hydrazine to give the corresponding pyridine derivatives.

the synthesis of pyridopyrimidin-3(5H)-one derivatives, and their cytotoxic activities against MCF- 7 cells.
the development of new anticancer agents and the design and synthesis of novel pyridopyridazine derivatives.
the synthesis and cytotoxic evaluation of novel pyridopyridazine derivatives against MCF- 7 cells.
